Actual composed bottom-only face for [[Kin Kian (V)|Kin Kian (V) (Errata)]] from page 2 of [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-October-2021-capture.pdf]], known by the 5 October 2021 archive capture. The lower statistics/text remain; upper title, destiny, lore and artwork are omitted. Nothing is filled or reconstructed. Original PDF coordinates [33.0, 556.0, 212.0, 638.0]; render matrix 745 divided by clip width, alpha=False. The original whole PDF and embedded page raster are preserved. [[Category:Card images]]
